RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Friday, November 12, 2010/Kartika 21, 1932 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Agriculture; Chemicals and Fertilizers; Consumer Affairs, Food
and Public Distribution; Human Resource Development; Micro, Small and
Medium Enterprises; Railways; Steel)
Total number of questions—20
13
Storage facility for foodgrains
*61. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of CONSUMER AFFAIRS,
FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION
be pleased to state:
(a) the quantum of foodgrains damaged
due to scarcity of storage facility during
the current year; and
(b) the details of steps taken or
proposed to be taken by Government to
raise foodgrain storage capacity by
adopting modern techniques for
preservation of foodgrains in the country
in order to avoid their damage?
Recruitment of teachers on contract
basis under SSA
*62. SHRI BIRENDRA PRASAD
BAISHYA: Will the Minister of HUMAN
RESOURCE DEVELOPMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether State Governments have
been allowed to recruit teachers on contract
basis for primary and secondary levels of
education, out of the funds provided by
the Central Government under Sarva
Shiksha Abhiyan (SSA);
(b) if so, the number of teachers
appointed so far, category-wise, and the
payment for which is due to the State
Government of Assam as envisaged under
this Scheme; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Use of fertilizers
†*63. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of  AGRICULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
imbalanced use of chemical fertilizers in
the country has caused huge damage to the
agricultural land of the country;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government in
this regard;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

14
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(c) whether Government has identified
those regions of the country where
maximum and minimum agricultural land
has been affected; and
(d) if so, the names of those States?
Subsidy to coconut farmers
*64. SHRI S. THANGA VELU: Will the
Minister of  AGRICULTURE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
formulate a plan to restructure the Coconut
Development Board (CDB) on the lines of
Rubber Board, since CDB is not functioning
successfully;
(b) whether Government will also
consider to provide subsidy to coconut
farmers to increase the production; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and follow-
up action taken by Government in this
regard?
Revamping of PDS
*65. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of
CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND
PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION be pleased to
refer to the answer to Unstarred Question
3393 given in the Rajya Sabha on 27 August,
2010 and state:
(a) whether Government has since taken
a decision to revamp the public distribution
system in the country in the light of the
recommendations made by the National
Advisory Council (NAC), recently;
(b) if so, the details thereof vis-a-vis
the recommendations of the Council; and
(c) if no action has so far been taken in
the matter, by when  the same is likely to
be taken?
Syllabus and medium of education in
schools
†*66. DR. PRABHA THAKUR: Will
the Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether there is difference in
syllabus of Government and private
schools;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether children in Government
schools also have the facility of opting for
English language as medium of education;
and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Demands of Chhattisgarh under PDS
†*67. SHRI SHREEGOPAL  VYAS:
Will the Minister of  CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:
(a) whether demands of Chhattisgarh
for rice and wheat for APL, re-
determination of BPL, foodgrain allocation
for welfare organisations and doing away
with reduction of kerosene have been met;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the future plan in that regard?
Damage to wheat for want of
warehouses
*68. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT:
Will the Minister of CONSUMER
AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC
DISTRIBUTION be pleased to state:

15
(a) the proper storage capacity for
wheat, rice and other cereals available in
different States, particularly in States with
large procurement;
(b) the quantity of wheat that got
damaged in different States for want of
proper warehousing; and
(c) the manner in which the damaged
wheat is proposed to be disposed of?
Vacant posts in Railways
*69. SHRI SABIR ALI: Will the
Minister of RAILWAYS be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of posts of running
staffers comprising loco drivers, assistant
loco drivers and motor-men, along with
those of top posts in the Indian Railways
lying vacant as on 31 March, 2010,
category-wise; and
(b) the steps taken to fill up these vacant
posts?
